Terms.title: Terms and Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to TuWebIdeal. By accessing our website and using our services, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions.

services.title: 1. Services
services.content: We offer web design and development services, SEO optimization, and maintenance. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any service at any time.

intellectual_property.content: All content, design, and code developed by TuWebIdeal remains our property until full payment for the agreed service is completed, at which point rights are transferred to the client, except for third-party software components.

payments.title: 3. Payments and Refunds
payments.content: Payments are made as agreed in the budget. No refunds are offered once work has started, except for serious breach on our part.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: We are not responsible for indirect damages, data loss, or service interruptions caused by third parties (hosting, domain providers, etc.).

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: This website uses cookies to improve user experience. Below we explain what they are and how we use them.

what_are.title: What are cookies?
what_are.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently.

what_use.title: What cookies do we use?
what_use.content_1: Currently, this website uses essential technical cookies for site operation, such as keeping you logged in (if applicable) or remembering your theme preferences (light/dark mode).
what_use.content_2: We do not use third-party cookies for advertising tracking nor do we sell your browsing data.

control.title: Cookie Control
control.content: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being placed.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At TuWebIdeal, we take your privacy very seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide voluntarily, such as your name, email, and phone number when using our contact form or hiring our services.

list.2: Contact you to respond to your inquiries.
list.3: Send relevant information about your project.

protection.title: 3. Data Protection
protection.content: We implement security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except when necessary to provide the service (e.g., hosting providers) or by legal requirement.
